World one — the dark side

The Human Performance Scientist.

Cold showers and 5am alarms don't fix a dysregulated nervous system. The men who change most aren't the ones who grind harder — they're the ones who regulate better.

You work hard. You provide. You show up. But your kids are forming their memories of you right now — and the clock doesn't pause while you think about it. This world exists for driven dads who are in the room, but not really there.
